name: Peter Who
source:
A SHORT GAME ABOUT EXPLORING IDENTITY.

This is a visual novel game that begins with the unknown about the game world. 

Accompanied by the development of the story, you will meet primitives and have the chance to fight against, integrate or change them even run away to explore your own identity. 

Three basic philosophical questions are mixed into the plot of the story, which is ‘Who am I’, ‘Where am I’, and ‘Where am I going’.

[From [url=https://zidianpan.itch.io/peterwho]Itch.io[/url]]
